notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, just updated SokoChess Black to version 1.0.1 with the following bug fixes.
[list]
[*] Fixed level 47 and 48 out of bounds issue where your piece could leave the board
[*] Fixed a visual bug where the icon would show the wrong result of capturing action
[/list]

I'm sorry for any inconvenience this may have caused you. Thank you for reporting these issues, if you run into more, let us know.

Have fun!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we just updated the demo!

We added 6 new languages that will be also available in the full game. You can now experience SokoChess Black in your mother tongue if you happen to speak Simplified Chinese, German, French, Spanish (Latin), Polish or Czech.

We hope you enjoy the update and are looking forward to the full release on November 13th 2023!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2482820/SokoChess_Black/
